notes: ExtraSensory dataset. 60 subjects (34 iPhone, 26 Android), 300k+ minutes (~308,320 examples), free-living/in-the-wild: subjects used their own personal phones in natural routine, with no scripted activities. Multi-label context (activities can co-occur), 51 context labels. Raw phone accelerometer examples use real timestamps and platform-dependent units; Pebble watch acceleration is approximately 25 Hz in milli-g. HALO uses this as an optional Phase-A scale source, not an evaluation set: phone examples require an explicit pocket or hand placement, watch examples form a wrist stream, and non-observable or ambiguous context labels are pruned. arXiv version 1609.06354 (23 pp) accepted to IEEE Pervasive Computing.
